digest.component_or_area: LLM provider factory and session management
propositions: Provider construction logic is currently scattered across multiple inline branches in runner.py:268, requiring separate handling for each new provider instead of a unified registration pattern

Client lifecycle (httpx.AsyncClient) cannot be properly managed through pydantic-ai's infer_model factory hook because the hook signature only returns a Provider, with no channel to return the client for later teardown
A ProviderSession object should own the provider factory callable and manage closeables (httpx clients) through context manager enter/exit, replacing the current ad-hoc finally-block teardown

The Anthropic provider builder must move into the new ProviderSession registry while preserving all existing behavior: tenacity transport, max_retries=0 guard, loopback-proxy bypass, and per-request timeout
Test imports of _build_retrying_anthropic_model must migrate from rebar.llm.runner to rebar.llm.anthropic_model to maintain the leaf-module convention

After run() returns or raises, every httpx.AsyncClient opened by the session must be verifiably closed on the real client object, and unknown provider names must raise LLMConfigError with registered names listed
